name: Beach City
note: Fan work from Steven Universe, which belongs to Rebecca Sugar and Cartoon Network; nothing from the show is used, and every shape here is this project's own geometry. Laid out after the map of Beach City published with the show (2014), north up: the town at the west end of a strip between Rehoboth Bay (north) and the Atlantic (south), the boardwalk along the ocean beach, Funland on a pier in the bay, and east of the town Lighthouse Park - the hill with the lighthouse on its tip and the Crystal Temple in the cliff at its east end, Steven's house at the statue's feet on a beach of its own, out of sight of the town. The ground, the streets and the plan are generated by tools/make-beachcity.py; the models are src/beachcity/. Positions are [lat, lon].
defaultView: The temple and the beach house
attribution: Beach City is fan work: geometry generated by tools/make-beachcity.py and src/beachcity/. Steven Universe belongs to Rebecca Sugar and Cartoon Network. No assets used.
_seaLevelWater: the whole box is sea at y = 0 and the ground decides: the beach, the town and the headland stand out of it
_windows: cottages and beach shops: plain painted walls, no office window grid; the landmarks carry their own openings

districts._: [name, hex colour, base height, tallest, box as [lat south, lon west, lat north, lon east]]

landmarks.name: The Crystal Temple
landmarks.info: The Crystal Gems' home, cut into the cliff at the tip of Lighthouse Park, facing the sea: a statue of Obsidian, the fusion of five of them, rising out of the sand to the top of the rock. Four of her eight arms close round the door at her navel; of the other four, three are broken off in the sand, and the top-right one still holds its hand up, palm open - Steven's washer and dryer are on it, and a warp pad.

landmarks.name: The beach house
landmarks.info: Greg built it over the temple's door, with the Gems' help, so that Steven could grow up in a house with a kitchen and a bathroom: one big room, a loft for Steven's bed, a deck across the front, all on tall posts, and a long stair down to the sand. It looks out to sea; the hill is at its back, and Beach City is on the other side of the hill.

landmarks.name: The Lighthouse
landmarks.info: On the tip of Lighthouse Park, above the temple, with a fence along the top of the cliff. Nobody knows whether it still works; Ronaldo uses the room at the top for his research into everything weird in Beach City. The round window over the door has a star in it.

landmarks.name: Lighthouse Park
landmarks.info: The long grassy hill between the town and the temple, with the lighthouse at its far end and a cliff of grey rock along its ocean side. The beach runs along under the cliff from the boardwalk round to Steven's house.

landmarks.name: Big Donut
landmarks.info: The donut shop on the corner at the east end of the boardwalk, at the foot of the hill, where Lars and Sadie work the counter: violet-brown walls, a pink and blue roof, pink and brown awnings, and on top the donut, in chocolate icing with pink, green and blue sprinkles.

landmarks.name: The T-shirt shop
landmarks.info: Novelty shirts, between the Big Donut and Fish Stew Pizza.

landmarks.name: Fish Stew Pizza
landmarks.info: The Pizza family's restaurant on the boardwalk - Kofi, Nanefua, Jenny and Kiki: a white building under a roof striped brick red and light green.

landmarks.name: Beach Citywalk Fries
landmarks.info: The Frymans' place on the boardwalk: a white building with a lot of windows and a big wooden sign in the shape of a box of fries.

landmarks.name: Funland Arcade
landmarks.info: Funland's arcade, on the boardwalk at the west end of town, open late, with a sign that lights up at dusk.

landmarks.name: Cone 'N' Son
landmarks.info: Ice cream, between the visitor center and the Funland Arcade.

landmarks.name: Beach City Visitor Center
landmarks.info: At the west end of the boardwalk, where Route 1A comes into town.

landmarks.name: Beach City Funland
landmarks.info: Mr. Smiley's amusement park, out on a pier in Rehoboth Bay on the north side of town: the Ferris wheel you can see from everywhere, a roller coaster, the teacups, a carousel, bumper cars, a drop tower and the midway.

landmarks.name: It's a Wash
landmarks.info: Greg's car wash, on the bay side of town at the foot of the hill: the wash bay and the office in an L, the elephant on the sign, and the van Greg lives in parked out the back.

landmarks.name: The old docks
landmarks.info: What is left of the docks on the bay shore, east of the car wash: piles and a few boards.

landmarks.name: The water tower
landmarks.info: Beach City's water tower, on the wooded hill at the north-west corner of town, over the bay.

landmarks.name: The boardwalk
landmarks.info: Planks on posts along the back of the beach, from under the headland to Funland, with the shops facing onto it and the sea on the other side.

landmarks.name: Brooding Hill
landmarks.info: The other cliff, at the west end of town over the ocean: from the top you can see all of Beach City, the beach, the sea, and Lighthouse Park at the far end with the lighthouse on it. The temple is round the far side of that hill, out of sight. People come up here to think.

landmarks.name: U-Stor
landmarks.info: Self storage at the north-west corner of town, on Waterman Street where Beach City Highway comes in.

landmarks.name: The Mayor's house
landmarks.info: Out on Beach City Highway past the water tower, with the flag on its pole by the porch.

landmarks.name: Dewey Park
landmarks.info: A block of grass between Main Street and Boardwalk Street, paths crossing it, and in the middle a statue of Captain William Dewey, who founded the town nearly two hundred years ago.

life._: gulls over the beaches and the bay, the surf, Funland's rides, the lighthouse's beam at night

_defaultHour: the engine's sun is over +x after noon (src/engine/stages/01-scene.js sunAt), and the temple faces +x, the sea: so it opens in the early afternoon
_terrainColours: the park's high ground olive and tan, as the background paintings have it; the steep slopes grass-grey; past the edge of the map, sea
